title: Identify the names and frame versions of cards illustrated by 'Allen Willia
question: Identify the names and frame versions of cards illustrated by 'Allen Williams' that are legal in the 'commander' format, have unknown power (either NULL or '*'), and belong to sets with expansion type 'expansion'. Among these, return only those with the highest converted mana cost within their respective sets.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049" AS name, T1."XCL_019" AS frame_version
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2."XCL_099" = T1."XCL_063"
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T3."XCL_086" = T1."XCL_072"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'Allen Williams'
  AND T3."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND T2."XCL_115" = 'expansion'
  AND T1."XCL_011" = (
      SELECT MAX(T4."XCL_011")
      FROM cards AS T4
      INNER JOIN sets AS T5 ON T5."XCL_099" = T4."XCL_063"
      INNER JOIN legalities AS T6 ON T6."XCL_086" = T4."XCL_072"
      WHERE T4."XCL_002" = 'Allen Williams'
        AND T6."XCL_084" = 'commander'
        AND T6."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
        AND (T4."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T4."XCL_055" = '*')
        AND T5."XCL_115" = 'expansion'
        AND T4."XCL_063" = T1."XCL_063"
  )
